import re, html

def clean_html(raw):
    text = re.sub(r'</?(p|h1|h2|h3|h4|li|tr|br|div|ul|ol|table)[^>]*>', '\n', raw)
    text = re.sub(r'</?(td|th)[^>]*>', ' | ', text)
    text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text)
    text = html.unescape(text)
    text = re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+', '\n', text)
    return text.strip()

with open("conf2_out.txt") as f:
